Upstream: https://github.com/syoyo/tinyvdb
Commit:   9217101 (branch main; merges volumetric-sdf and PR #5's tight
          NanoVDB bounding-box fix)
Files:    the src/ subset needed by tvdb_mesh_to_level_set,
          tvdb_level_set_to_tet_mesh / tvdb_sdf_to_tet_mesh,
          tvdb_grid_volume_to_mesh, the volume access used by usdVol
          (tvdb_read_grid, tinyvdb_volume, tvdb_grid_to_nanovdb) and the I/O:
          tinyvdb_io.h (+ tinyvdb_io.c wrapper, lightusd's own), checked,
          mc_tri_table, mesh, mesh_conversion(.inl), ops.h, ray.h, sdf_tree,
          sparse, sparse_tools, sparse_tree, stats.h, tetmesh, tet_refine,
          tet_graded, thread,
          to_nanovdb (+ third_party/nanovdb/PNanoVDB.h, Apache-2.0, OpenVDB
          contributors), tree, tree_internal, volume, winding, tvdb_memory,
          lifecycle; and
          gpu_compute(.h, .c, _internal.h), nanovdb_device.h (+ generated string),
          built only with
          LIGHTUSD_TINYVDB_GPU.
Local:    tinyvdb_io.c is LightUSD's wrapper, not upstream's parser. tinyvdb_io.h
          adapts includes to ../miniz.h, ../../lz4/lz4.h and ../zstd.h.
          tinyvdb_sparse_tools.c also carries LightUSD commit dad7e2b7's CPU
          mesher optimization: detect shell isovalue crossings while gathering
          the shell, avoiding a redundant full-box scan. tinyvdb_tetmesh.c
          parallelizes stuffing over z slabs for pools with multiple workers;
          each slab uses compact local maps and the final merge follows the
          original z/y/x traversal, preserving byte-identical output. Its
          multi-worker warp now uses ordered corner/center wavefronts over
          increasing coordinate sums, preserving serial neighbor dependencies
          and byte-identical output across worker counts.
Update:   the vendored API sources match upstream main at 9217101, apart from
          the local I/O adaptations and CPU changes above. When syncing later
          revisions, preserve those local changes and rebuild
          cmake/lightusd-tinyvdb.cmake's source list if the dependency closure
          changes (link a probe calling the entry points above).
